subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Transmission
description: Learn The Transmission in one minute.

hook.text: An engine spins fast but wheels need to turn slow with lots of force. Something has to translate.

buildup.text: That's the transmission—a set of gears that converts engine speed into wheel speed at different ratios.

discovery.text: Low gears multiply torque for starting and climbing. High gears let the engine cruise at low RPM.

twist.text: Without a transmission, you'd need an impossibly large engine just to merge onto a highway.

climax.text: Modern automatics have 8 to 10 gears, constantly picking the perfect ratio for you.

punchline.text: Gears are the translator between engine and road.

quiz.question: Why do cars need multiple gears?
options: To match engine speed to wheel needs
